info.title: azsb
info.description: Terminal UI for browsing Azure Service Bus namespaces, queues, topics, and messages.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Terminal UI for browsing Azure Service Bus namespaces, queues, topics, and messages

commands.name: config
commands.description:
Read and write settings in the config file, like git config:
get <key>: print a value, exit code 1 when unset; unset <key>: remove it
set <key> <value>: true/false and integers are stored as such, the rest as text
list [--all]: print key=value lines, secrets masked; path: print the config file's path

options.name: --all
options.description: With list: also the known keys that are unset, with their default and description
